title: NAVIGAIT: Navigating Dynamically Feasible Gait Libraries using Deep Reinforcement Learning
venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
abstract: We estimate operator intention with an LSTM-based network to safely select among multiple safety filters—each defined by a different backup strategy—selecting behaviors that better align with operator intent while maintaining safety. We validate the approach through simulations and hardware experiments.
